caption: This drawing depicts an oval-shaped serving tray with three short, decorative legs. The tray has a scalloped, ornate rim with multiple curved segments around the edge, and it is presented in a three-quarter, slightly elevated perspective. The shading uses grayscale to suggest a metallic surface with light reflecting off the tray, especially on the right side. The legs are detailed with a curled design ending in a shell-like or fan-shaped base. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned. The artist's name, "Vincent Carneo," is inscribed in the lower left corner in simple, uppercase letters. The entire composition is rendered with fine pencil or graphite lines and gradient shading, and the palette consists solely of shades of gray against an off-white or light beige background.
title: Silver Salver
